answer: Stop sybils with a checkpoint passport: one doorway in, no side doors. First, a newcomer enters through the inlet and completes 20 micro-tasks, with a marble-stamped record of timing and output quality. Second, a reef of 50 peers spot-checks a random 10% weekly, and a failed check freezes the passport 30 days. Third, trust grows only with completed work, never new accounts. Forging 1,000 fakes would cost $240,000 in fees and 20,000 hours of work, dwarfing any sybil reward. An economy with one inlet is like a reef harbor: every boat is seen, and smugglers find no dark cove.
